 ZIM vs AFG 1st Test Day 2 Highlights: Bennett's Century Powers Zimbabwe to 504
 Follow us on WhatsApp for latest updates! Explore More Zimbabwe enjoyed a productive second day against Afghanistan in the opening Test, with Brian Bennett leading the batting charge through a superb century at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium. Afghanistan responded with a determined batting effort, but the visitors retained a substantial advantage at the end of play.
 Zimbabwe finished their first innings at 504, while Afghanistan reached 113/1 at stumps, leaving the hosts 391 runs behind.
 The ZIM vs AFG 1st Test Day 2 highlights feature Bennett's impressive 128, Madhevere's attacking half-century and Afghanistan's fightback through their opening partnership. Bennett faced 206 deliveries and struck 11 boundaries, while Wessly Madhevere added 54 from 70 balls to push Zimbabwe beyond the 400-run mark. Afghanistan's Qais Ahmad and Mohammad Saleem Safi claimed three wickets apiece, but neither could prevent the visitors from crossing the 500-run milestone.
 Afghanistan's response began with an early dismissal as Newman Nyamhuri removed Abdul Malik for just two runs. However, Zimbabwe struggled to make further inroads as Rahmanullah Zadran and Sediqullah Atal took charge of the innings.
 The two Afghan batters produced an impressive display of patience, both reaching Test milestones. Atal remained unbeaten on 55, while Rahmanullah finished the day on 50 not out. Their 99-run stand for the second wicket gave Afghanistan a much-needed platform after the early setback.
 With Zimbabwe holding a 391-run lead, the pressure remains on Afghanistan to build a substantial first-innings total on Day 3. Fans can watch the AFG vs ZIM 1st Test highlights on tapmad to catch Bennett's century, Madhevere's aggressive batting and Afghanistan's resilient response.
